text: AC6 called itself the one deliberate exception to C-5, which a drafted spec has no standing to make — the constitution's opening lines say it outranks every spec. Reframed: contradiction blocking is not a threshold, so C-5 does not reach it. Also names the departure from PAWL-026 AC5, which warns on unknown policy keys deliberately; warning on a key whose purpose is to weaken a refusal would leave an operator believing they had configured a tolerance the gate ignored
